title: Exclude arbitrary mixed-rank active repair below rank eight
body:
Any number of immutable channels of mixed Gaussian ranks **1 through 7** needs at least **65 units of rank mass** to repair all eight modes of the exact F9 source. This permits arbitrary rational payloads, repeated chronological scatter and joint noise cancellation, while granting free helper restoration. For every power tariff `H_r=r^q H_1`, `0<q<=1`, its price is at least **65/64 times the removed 8H8 allowance**. No new kappa is claimed.

This resolves the lower-rank part of the released question in [PR5755](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5755) and [PR5745](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5745). Exact quotient-rank cuts replace the insufficient coordinate-cover test. The census has **22,585 events, 641 roles, 1,002 charts and 8,298 temporal responses**. Stronger rank-mass bounds are 90 for maximum rank five and 77 for maximum rank six. A cost-62 integral cover on 17 rank-at-most-four charts reaches every coordinate but misses five of the eight target directions.

[Proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f7c198d38d5f68b0753dd0a51a2328e145b07638/research/active-mixed-rank-obstruction/PROOF.md), [exact certificates](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f7c198d38d5f68b0753dd0a51a2328e145b07638/research/active-mixed-rank-obstruction/CERTIFICATES.json), [complete receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f7c198d38d5f68b0753dd0a51a2328e145b07638/research/active-mixed-rank-obstruction/RESULT.json), [discovery limits](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f7c198d38d5f68b0753dd0a51a2328e145b07638/research/active-mixed-rank-obstruction/DISCOVERY.md), [validation](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f7c198d38d5f68b0753dd0a51a2328e145b07638/research/active-mixed-rank-obstruction/VALIDATION.md).

Verification uses Python3.12.14 and the standard library. Normal and optimized registered runs pass. The checker rebuilds all240 quotient cuts, every exact dual capacity, six support-cover primal/dual optima, the source's initial restored-Y invariant and all115 predecessor rank-one supports. Seven semantic controls, a joint-noise positive control and three actual source corruptions pass. It imports no predecessor executable or optimizer. Metadata, committed bytes/modes and the official18-file export pass. A read-only Git-free optimized replay with empty PATH passed in6.92 seconds and preserved all19 files including the manifest.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/active-mixed-rank-obstruction
```

The contract keeps the native word and each channel's chart and payload fixed. Rank-eight/rank-nine mixtures, moving frames and changed feedback remain open. The native common-fixed-vector specialization is a retained premise; no new physical caller, compiler, precision/tape, analytic or outer theorem is supplied. Full-history preflight was not run in this shallow checkout. Hosted scientific replay and independent acceptance are not claimed. The selected frontier is unchanged.

Base canonical main: `de5ec2e7a6074068452f45b1a191b5c72832df4a`, priority8, refreshed before publication. Live handoffs and open-PR overlap were checked; sparse local notes and unpublished work remain limits. [Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5125#discussioncomment-19205279). Exact publication head: `f7c198d38d5f68b0753dd0a51a2328e145b07638`.

Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents. Apache-2.0. Credit flyingviper/PR5755 for the restored-Y invariant and independent rank-one census, PR5720 for the active-mode proposal, PR5745 for the temporal contract and eight-H8 attainment, Cao Yifan, Cinna Davis, Dugongue and every author retained in the unchanged source archive. The new result is the arbitrary mixed-rank quotient certificate; predecessor construction credit is preserved. No merge or frontier change is requested.
